product_metadata.title: Insieme 12" Extra Wide Bed Bridge Twin to King Converter Kit – Use to Easily Combine 2 Twins to King or Plug Gap Between Split King Adjustable Mattresses. V-Shaped Wedge, Light, Thin & Strapless.
features: Sleep Like a King - Upgrade your bedroom with our premium bed bridge for split king adjustable bed, split queen adjustable bed or stationary beds. Designed to cover the gap between two mattresses and fold around the contours when they are adjusted. You'll love sleeping in your bed again and so will your pets. If you have an adjustable bed with mattress this is a must-have among bed accessories.

Unique V-Shape Bed Gap Filler - This nearly 12" wide bed bridge fully fills gaps up to 2” between twin or twin XL beds and acts as a bed wedge mattress gap filler with no strap needed. The V-Shaped foam wedge provides natural support and evenly distributes weight - meaning you, your kids & your small pets can safely sleep in the middle of your new combined bed.

Elevate Your Comfort - Imagine waking up every morning refreshed and ready to start the day. The soft-touch fabric cover on our bed doubling system makes that possible. Made from hypoallergenic bamboo fiber fabric you'll stay cool and comfortable all night long

Simple, Easy, Convenient - For split king or split queen adjustable beds simply insert the mattress connector wedge side down into the gap. For regular mattresses use this twin bed connector to make a king by pushing the two mattresses together and placing the bed bridge on top between them. You can lay directly on top of it or cover it with a mattress pad or fitted sheet for extra stability. When not in use everything fits in the convenient storage bag with carry handle.

100% Money Back Guarantee - Here at Insieme we always put the customer first. That's why we offer a no questions asked refund policy. If you're not completely satisfied with our bed bridge we'll give you back every penny.
